gorillaUpdate.notes:
Gorilla WWE 2K26 Mod Manager v1.0.1 - Emergency Save Protection Hotfix
- Mod Doctor now copies and SHA-256 verifies the complete WWE 2K26 Steam save before moving any CAK. - If the save cannot be found or verified, diagnosis stops before any mod changes. - The protected save is restored between diagnosis rounds and with Restore Original Setup. - Current post-test save files are retained during atomic restoration instead of being deleted. - WWE launch is blocked if the protected backup later fails verification. - Mod Doctor cannot be closed while test CAKs remain separated. - Existing CAK profile, hash, rollback and unmanaged-mod safety behavior is unchanged.
